build_artifact_discriminator: build a function that loads a convnext_tiny artifact discriminator model from a checkpoint file
optimize_image: optimize an image by minimizing artifact detection through gradient-based optimization
extract_watermark: extract the watermark from an original image and its optimized version as a pixel difference
run_watermark_extraction_cli: run the CLI tool to extract watermarks from an image using a model checkpoint
transform_image: transform a PIL image to a normalized tensor with RGB conversion and resizing to 768x768
